meta.name: alterlab-medchem
meta.description: Applies medicinal-chemistry filters with the medchem library — drug-likeness rules (Lipinski, Veber), PAINS filters, structural alerts, and molecular complexity metrics for compound prioritization and library cleanup. Use when filtering or triaging a compound library, flagging PAINS or reactive groups, or assessing drug-likeness of candidate molecules. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 筛选化合物库中的药物相似性分子
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理化合物库并需要快速评估药物相似性
copy.tagline_en: Filter compound libraries for drug-like molecules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing compound libraries and need to assess drug-likeness

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能对化合物分子进行药物化学过滤：判断是否符合 Lipinski 五规则等成药性规则，检测 PAINS 等结构警示，计算分子复杂度，并筛选出符合要求的分子。
howto.when: 当你需要筛选化合物库、评估候选分子的成药性，或标记含有 PAINS 等警示结构的分子时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个分子是否符合 Lipinski 五规则。
say.note: Claude 会调用规则过滤函数，返回该分子是否通过。

say.text: 过滤掉含有 PAINS 警示结构的化合物。
计算这批分子的 Bertz 复杂度，保留前 99% 的分子。
say.note: Claude 会调用复杂度过滤器，返回复杂度在阈值内的分子。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can apply medicinal-chemistry filters to molecules: check drug-likeness rules (Lipinski, Veber), detect structural alerts (PAINS, etc.), calculate molecular complexity, and filter compounds accordingly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to filter a compound library, assess drug-likeness of candidate molecules, or flag PAINS or reactive groups.

say_en.text: Check if this molecule passes Lipinski's Rule of Five.
say_en.note: Claude will call the rule filter and return a boolean.

say_en.text: Filter out molecules containing PAINS alerts.
say_en.note: Claude will run the structural alert filter and return clean molecules.

say_en.text: Calculate Bertz complexity for these molecules, keep those within the 99th percentile.
say_en.note: Claude will call the complexity filter and return molecules within limit.
